name: Iran's leadership: the Supreme Leader, the IRGC and the Supreme National Security Council
role: Supreme Leader Mojtaba Khamenei (reported; named in Polymarket's leadership market), the Revolutionary Guards, the president and the council
wants: Regime survival after the 02/28/2026 strike that killed Ali Khamenei (ev-ir-khamenei-killed).
An end to the US blockade without giving up enrichment (inferred; the Polymarket deal-terms markets price enrichment concessions under 15%).
Control over, or a toll on, Strait of Hormuz traffic (inferred from the Hormuz fee and agreement markets).
fears: A coup or a split between the Guards and the clerical leadership (inferred; Polymarket prices a coup attempt by 12/31/2026 at about 6%).
constraints: The Leader commands the armed forces and declares war and peace (ev-ir-constitution-art110); the system rests on velayat-e faqih (ev-ir-constitution-art5).
The blockade since 04/13/2026, reinstated 07/13/2026, cuts oil income (tl-2026-04-13-blockade).
red_lines: Giving up the enriched stockpile: priced at 5% by 12/31/2026 on Polymarket (reported market price, not a statement).
who_can_remove_them: The Assembly of Experts can dismiss the Leader (stated; constitution, verify the article).
tells: A general closure of Iranian airspace (indicator airspace; Polymarket prices one by 11/30 at 18%).
Persian-language feeds: IRNA, Mehr, Fars, BBC Persian, Iran International (config/sources.json).
GPS jamming over the Gulf (indicator gps_jamming).
Fires at energy and nuclear sites (indicator infrastructure_fire).

record.what: First direct missile and drone attack on Israel
Ali Khamenei killed in the opening strikes; a temporary leadership council announced 03/01
Ceasefire collapses after attacks on ships in the Strait

open_questions: Confirm the successor from an official Iranian source; the profile still says to.
